The study reveals abnormal PF joint alignment; mild lateral patellofemoral subluxation with evidence of   
  trochlear dysplasia type C( lateral convexitymedial hypoplasia) according to the Dejour classification.  
 Measurement indices;  
   patella alta  patella height ratioT/P= 1.39  
  Trochlear facet asymmetry ( MF/LF) ratio= intact32 ( normal > intact4)  
   Lateral  trochlea inclination = 12 degree ( normal > 11)  
   Trochlear groove depth = 3.13 mm.      ( normal > 3mm.)  
  
  Minimal bone contusion at the anterior medial femoral condyle is observed.  
  Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen.  
  Osteochondral lesion, 1.1cm. at mid lateral femoral condyle with mild subchondral bone edema and few subchondral cysts detected. No displaced fragment is detected.  Thinning overlying articular cartilage at Wtbearing part of the lateral femoral condyle is observed.  
  Fissuring patellar cartilage surface with delamination tear, about 7.5mm. at mid lateral patellar level is detected.  
   Stretching, laxity of the medial patellar retinaculum is observed.  
  MCL is intact.    Medial meniscus is not torn. 
  FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.       
  Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
  Normal orientation with intact ACL fiber is observed.   PCL is intact.  
   Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.  Evidence of PF instability,

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Condromalacia rotuliana.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los cartílagos
femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales espesor parcial y prácticamente total de distribución difusa de la rótula, sin
cambios óseos secundarios.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Pequeña formación quística profunda de la grasa de Hoffa, adyacente al cuerno anterior del
menisco lateral de 12 x 10 mm en sus ejes mayores, uno un ganglión. No hay signos de
complicación regional.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula.
Pequeño ganglión profundo de la grasa de Hoffa adyacente al cuerno anterior del menisco lateral,
sin signos de complicación.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.

Moderate suprapatellar effusion, there are no intra-articular bodies.
Both menisci appear intact, as do the cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, distal iliotibial band and extensor tendons.
Well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces, save for a tiny cartilage fissure present just lateral to the median patellar ridge, with similar appearances being noted at the medial facet of the distal femoral trochlea. 
No fracture or marrow infiltration.  Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

FINDINGS:

Fractures:
None.

Joint alignment:
Normal.

Degenerative changes:
Focal high to full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral femoral condyle and tibia posteriorly. This is most likely related to a prior osteochondral injury.

Mild cartilage loss in the patellofemoral cartilage with thinning of the patellar cartilage inferiorly.

Bone marrow signal:
Normal. Subchondral cysts involving the lateral tibial plateau.

Anterior cruciate ligament: Mild signal abnormality involving the ACL ligament at the posterior insertion to the femur, likely related to a mild sprain.
Posterior cruciate ligament: Normal.
Medial collateral ligament: Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament complex: The fibular collateral ligament, IT band and biceps femoris are intact. Signal abnormality involving the popliteus tendon insertion at the lateral femoral condyle, most likely tendinosis. The popliteomeniscal fascicles are not well seen and likely torn, with associated mild medial displacement of the popliteus tendon below the popliteus hiatus.

Medial meniscus: Normal.
Lateral meniscus: Complex multidirectional tear involving the posterior, body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is volume loss in the body and a large displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. There is complete loss of tissue in the posterior horn, likely a complete radial tear. There is unusual U shaped fragment adjacent to the posterior root ligament.

Extensor mechanism: Normal.
Patellar retinacula: Normal.
Pes anserinus: Normal.

Posteromedial and posterolateral corner: Normal.

Joint effusion: Small to moderate right knee joint effusion, with synovial thickening. There is a small loose body in the suprapatellar recess measuring approximately 3 mm.
Baker cyst: None.

Other significant findings:
None.

CONCLUSION:
*Complex multidirectional tear of the body, posterior and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus, with a large unusually shaped displaced fragment in the intercondylar notch. Recommend an orthopedic surgery consultation.
*Mild signal abnormality of the ACL, likely from a sprain, without evidence of tear.
*Focal high to full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral compartment posteriorly, most significantly the posterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha.
Hallazgos:
Formación quística subcortical del aspecto anterior del platillo tibial medial de 7 x 6 mm en sus
ejes mayores, sin significado patológico específico.
No hay otras alteraciones de señal de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales. Cartílago
troclear sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial del cartílago rotuliano su faceta
lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Aumento de señal de la inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los compartimentos femorotibiales.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico, podría
representar fenómenos de mal alineamiento rotuliano.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
